title: When resistance keeps arguing with Hukam under pressure
issueStatement: The mind wants reality to arrive on self-approved terms. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru reframes peace as understanding the command already holding everything. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: Peace begins when the mind stops arguing with what already stands inside Hukam. Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with.
actionPrompt: Name one thing already here that you need to stop negotiating with. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
